basic_info.description: 578-586 Guerrero Street presents a rare opportunity to acquire a well-maintained six-unit apartment building in San Francisco's coveted Mission Dolores neighborhood. Ideally located between the vibrant Valencia Corridor and iconic Dolores Park and within walking distance to Noe Valley's 24th Street the property offers excellent access to top lifestyle amenities. Built in 1913, the building sits on a 2,000 SF lot with approx. 3,635 SF of space. The desirable unit mix includes 3 x studios, 2 x one-bed apartments, and 1 x two-bed and two-bath plus bonus room flat, which will be delivered vacant, ideal for an owner-user or value-add investor. Units offer natural light, functional layouts, and San Francisco charm. Recent capital improvements include a completed seismic retrofit (2019) and fire alarm upgrade (2023). In a walkable, transit-rich location near MUNI, BART, and major freeways, residents enjoy access to cafes, restaurants, and cultural hotspots. This asset offers strong income, long-term stability, and growth potential. 7.03% cap and 9.66 GRM
